title: EVT-REGISTRATION
description: Device announcement and keepalive, device to PC, every 2 s. The publisher records the source address and forgets a device after 6 s of silence - three missed keepalives.

deviceId.description: Lowercase hex of the six-byte station MAC, OUI byte first, no delimiter. Derived, never stored. Identifying - excluded from captures.

firmwareVersion.description: Carried so a version mismatch is diagnosable from the PC side, at the moment the panel is least able to help.
